classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: Target PDB file will be supplied at execution time via params.target_pdb; no structure is embedded in this plan.
Hotspot residues are not specified; bindcraft automated hotspot detection will be used for both shards.
Two trajectory shards (seed=1, seed=2, num_designs=1 each) stay within default_max_parallel=2 and satisfy recommended_shard_size=1.
binder_length=60 (tool default) is a reasonable compact starting point; no domain-specific length constraint was provided.
num_recycles=1 (minimal) reduces GPU time while still allowing basic AF2 backbone refinement.

sequence_analysis runs on the binder sequence only; no structure-based quality tool is available in the selected set, so per-residue composition and liability metrics serve as a structural-quality proxy.
No submit_candidate node is included; ranking output informs a post-workflow submission decision made after actual outputs are reviewed.
plan.goal: Design two binder candidates (one per trajectory seed) against a user-supplied target PDB using BindCraft, evaluate sequence composition and liabilities, aggregate into a ranked top-2 candidate list.
missing_inputs: Target PDB file path (params.target_pdb) must be provided at execution time.
Hotspot residues not specified — bindcraft will use automated detection; results may be less targeted than if hotspots were supplied.

success_criteria.ranked_candidates: top_k=2 binder designs ranked by bindcraft design metrics combined with sequence-analysis quality scores
success_criteria.artifacts: ranked_json and ranked_tsv files from rank_designs, plus per-candidate sequence metrics and liability annotations
